text:
## Escalation Matrix  
**Complaint Escalation by Severity & Involvement:**  
| Level | Authority | Timeline | Complaints |
|-------|-----------|----------|-----------|
| **Frontline** | Customer Service Agent | <1 day | Simple, low-value |
| **Manager** | Complaints Manager | <5 days | Moderate issues, <£500 loss |
| **Director** | Head of Customer Service | <8 days | Significant issues, £500–£2,000 loss |
| **Escalated** | CEO/Board | 8+ weeks | Major failures, >£2,000 loss, reputational risk |  
**Escalation Triggers:**
- Complaint unresolved after manager review
- Financial compensation >£500 (Director) or >£2,000 (CEO)
- Regulatory or reputational concern
- Media/legal involvement
- Customer escalates to FCA

raw_entities.name: Complaint Escalation Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy governing the escalation of customer complaints through defined authority levels based on severity, financial loss, and involvement triggers. The policy establishes timelines and decision-makers at each escalation stage, from frontline resolution through CEO/Board review.
context: Complaint Escalation by Severity & Involvement
Escalation Triggers: Complaint unresolved after manager review, Financial compensation >£500 (Director) or >£2,000 (CEO), Regulatory or reputational concern

raw_entities.name: Frontline Complaint Resolution Requirement
raw_entities.description: Customer Service Agents must resolve simple, low-value complaints at frontline level within one day.
context: Frontline | Customer Service Agent | <1 day | Simple, low-value

raw_entities.name: Manager-Level Complaint Review Requirement
raw_entities.description: Complaints Managers must review and resolve moderate issues involving losses under £500 within five days.
context: Manager | Complaints Manager | <5 days | Moderate issues, <£500 loss

raw_entities.name: Director-Level Complaint Review Requirement
raw_entities.description: Head of Customer Service must review significant complaints involving losses between £500 and £2,000 within eight days.
context: Director | Head of Customer Service | <8 days | Significant issues, £500–£2,000 loss

raw_entities.name: CEO/Board Escalation Requirement
raw_entities.description: Major complaints involving losses exceeding £2,000, major failures, or reputational risk must be escalated to CEO/Board for review within eight weeks or longer.
context: Escalated | CEO/Board | 8+ weeks | Major failures, >£2,000 loss, reputational risk

raw_entities.name: Escalation Trigger - Unresolved After Manager Review
raw_entities.description: Any complaint that remains unresolved following manager review must be escalated to the next authority level.
context: Escalation Triggers: Complaint unresolved after manager review

raw_entities.name: Escalation Trigger - Financial Compensation Threshold
raw_entities.description: Complaints requiring financial compensation exceeding £500 must be escalated to Director level; those exceeding £2,000 must reach CEO/Board.
context: Financial compensation >£500 (Director) or >£2,000 (CEO)

raw_entities.name: Escalation Trigger - Regulatory or Reputational Concern
raw_entities.description: Complaints involving regulatory or reputational concerns must be escalated beyond manager level.
context: Regulatory or reputational concern

raw_entities.name: Escalation Trigger - Media or Legal Involvement
raw_entities.description: Complaints involving media or legal involvement must be escalated to senior management or CEO/Board.
context: Media/legal involvement

raw_entities.description: Any complaint escalated by the customer to the FCA must trigger immediate escalation within the bank's hierarchy.
